天大的秘密（天大的秘密（第22页）韩林跟着坐下，并取出茶具烧水沏茶，“叶道友此番前来，可是有什么吩咐？”“那倒不是，没有特别要紧的事情，叶家不会主动要求你们这些记名客卿做什么的。”叶见春摆摆手，随后取出一本薄薄的蓝皮小册子，以及一个储物袋递给韩林。“我是给你送任务清单，以及一些日常用品过来的，不是什么贵重的东西，但也算是我叶家的一点心意。”“这种小事，怎劳叶道友你亲自跑一趟，随便遣个人送来不就得了吗。”韩林接过小册子和储物袋，放在角落。叶见春道：“其实除了送东西过来之外，我还有件事情想跟黄道友你商量一下。”“什么事，叶道友但说无妨。”“是这样，青锋他已经筑基圆满，但叶家能提升结丹成功率的宝药，还需要一定时间才能成熟！青锋他已经等不及了，所以，我想问问黄道友你，有没有兴趣陪青锋出去游历一番？”“历练？”韩林疑惑道，“叶道友的意思，是让我保护青锋兄弟，出去寻找结丹机缘吗？”叶见春点点头，“就是这个意思！你放心，不会让你白白出力，不管出去有没有收获，在回来的时候，我都给你三十万高级贡献作为奖励的！”“三十万高级贡献！”韩林心中一惊，好奇道：“能兑换多少中品灵石呢？”叶见春道：“在叶家，一点高级贡献相当于一颗中品灵石，如果你全部兑换，就是三十万中品灵石！”“这么多。”韩林有点难以置信。叶见春道：“这是自然的！不过有个前提，就是我儿必须完好无损地回来。”“历练有时间限制吗？总不能历练个十年吧？”韩林觉得如果时间不长，这倒真是个赚钱的好机会。“十年吧，十年之后不管青锋有没有结丹成功，你们都可以回来了。”叶见春给出一个期限。十年时间，叶家的‘入道丹’差不多也能炼制出来了，到时即便叶青锋没有寻到结丹机缘，也可以回来领取入道丹。十年。听到这个数字，韩林皱了皱眉头，“这，似乎有点久了啊。”给人当保镖，一年才赚三万高级贡献，让他不太满意。叶见春道：“黄道友，十年三十万可不少了！若非看你年轻天赋不错，我是不会把这个机会给你的。”“我们叶家，有不少金丹后期客卿，交给他们，我儿还会更加安全一些。”“叶道友不说此话，我还真没想起，如此重要的事情，你为何不交给实力更强之人呢？”韩林惊疑道。“是这样的！我已经给青锋找到了一条明路，但这条明路不是谁都可以陪他走的！他需要一个天才。”“我不明白。”韩林越听越迷糊，“叶道友能说得详细些？”叶见春摇摇头，“除非你先答应接下任务，不然我不会告诉你原因，因为这涉及到一个天大的秘密！这个秘密，向来只有叶家最核心的几人才知道。”“就连我儿青锋，目前也不知情……。”

The Big Secret (The Big Secret (Page 22)) Han Lin sat down and took out the tea set to boil water and make tea. "Fellow Daoist Ye is here this time, but what are your instructions?" "That's not the case. It's not particularly important. The Ye family will not ask you, the guest guests, to do anything." Ye Jianchun waved his hands, then took out a thin blue booklet and a storage bag and handed them to Han Lin. "I'm here to send you your appointment. It's not something expensive, but it's a little thought from my Ye family. "Why don't you just send someone to deliver it in person?" Han Lin took the pamphlet and the storage bag and put them in the corner. Ye Jianchun said: "Actually, besides sending things over, I have something else I want to discuss with you." "What's the matter, Ye?" Fellow Daoist, it's okay." "That's right, Qingfeng has completed his foundation building, but the Ye family's treasure that can improve the success rate of forming pills will take some time to mature! Qingfeng, he can't wait any longer, so I would like to ask fellow Daoist Huang if you are interested in traveling with Qingfeng?" "Experience?" Han Lin asked, "Do you want me to protect Brother Qingfeng and go out to find opportunities for forming pills?" Nodding, "That's what I mean! Don't worry, your efforts will not be in vain. Regardless of whether you gain something or not, I will give you 300,000 high-level contributions as a reward when you come back!" "300,000 high-level contributions!" Han Lin was surprised and asked curiously: "How many middle-grade spiritual stones can be exchanged?" Ye Jianchun said: "In the Ye family, one high-level contribution is equivalent to one medium-grade spiritual stone. If you exchange all of it, it will be 300,000. "So many." Ye Jianchun said, "It's natural! But there is a prerequisite, that is, my son must come back intact." "Is there a time limit for training?" Han Lin thinks that if it doesn't last long, this is a good opportunity to make money. "Ten years later, regardless of whether Qing Feng succeeds in forming the pill." Ye Jianchun gave a time limit. In ten years, the Ye family's "Entering the Dao Pill" can be refined. Even if Ye Qingfeng does not find the opportunity to form the pill, he can come back to receive the "Entering the Dao Pill" in ten years. Hearing this number, Han Lin frowned, "This seems a bit long." He was not satisfied with being a bodyguard and only earning 30,000 yuan a year. A lot! If I hadn't seen that you were young and talented, I wouldn't have given you this opportunity." "We have a lot of late Jindan guests in our Ye family. If we leave it to them, my son would be safer." "If Fellow Daoist Ye didn't say this, I really didn't think of it, why didn't you leave such an important matter to someone with more strength?" "That's right! Not everyone can accompany him! "I don't understand." Han Lin became more and more confused. "Can you give me more details?" Ye Jianchun shook his head, "I won't tell you the reason unless you agree to take over the task first! This secret has always been known to only the core members of the Ye family..."
